title: Diwali - Festival of Lights
description: Celebrated nationwide with lamps, rangoli, and auspicious metalwork gifts.

title: Holi - Festival of Colors
description: Vibrant spring festival featuring natural dye celebrations, herbal colors, and traditional folk music.

title: Navratri & Garba
description: Nine nights of rhythmic folk dance with stunning Bandhani tie-dye attire and mirror-work embroidery.

title: Durga Puja
description: Grand socio-cultural celebration featuring spectacular pandal art, Kantha embroidery, and clay idols.

title: Onam Harvest Festival
description: Kerala harvest festival showcasing snake boat races, traditional Kasavu handlooms, and coir decor.

title: Pongal Harvest Festival
description: Tamil Nadu harvest festival worshipping the Sun God, adorned with Kanchipuram silk sarees and Kolam art.

title: Rongali Bihu
description: Assamese spring harvest festival marked by folk dance in exquisite golden Muga silk mekhela chadors.

title: Ganesh Chaturthi
description: Celebration of Lord Ganesha featuring hand-molded terracotta idols and traditional Paithani silk drapery.

title: Puri Rath Yatra
description: Grand chariot festival displaying traditional Pattachitra painted icons and Pipli applique canopies.

title: Lohri
description: Winter harvest festival of Punjab featuring vibrant Phulkari dupattas, folk music, and bonfire gatherings.

title: Makar Sankranti & Kite Festival
description: Solar harvest festival celebrated with kite flying, block printed quilts, and brass sweets platters.

title: Ugadi New Year
description: Deccan New Year celebrated with floral decorations, sandalwood fragrance, and handloom silks.

title: Vishu New Year
description: Malayali New Year showcasing auspicious Vishukkani arrangements, polished brass lamps, and Aranmula mirrors.

title: Hornbill Festival
description: Inter-tribal cultural extravaganza showcasing indigenous Naga woven shawls, woodcraft, and warrior dances.

title: Pushkar Camel Fair
description: World famous cultural fair featuring traditional puppet shows, leather craft, and Meenakari jewelry.
